title: Boundary Dynamics, Cubical Actions, and Infinite Girth
summary: We develop two methods for proving infinite girth from boundary dynamics. First, we use topologically free extreme boundary actions to give a boundary-dynamical proof of infinite girth for finitely generated acylindrically hyperbolic groups. The second combines Nakamura's criterion with, respectively, flag-space and Roller-boundary dynamics, yielding infinite-girth results for semisimple $S$-algebraic groups and for essential non-elementary actions on finite-dimensional, second countable, non-Euclidean CAT(0) cube complexes.
